import builtins
from typing import NoReturn

import pytest


def log_line(level: str, message: str) -> None:
    """Print one log line to standard output as ``[level] message``.

    Writes only to the console. Never opens or writes any file.
    """
    print(f"[{level}] {message}")


def test_prints_formatted_line(capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str]) -> None:
    log_line("INFO", "service started")
    captured = capsys.readouterr()
    assert captured.out == "[INFO] service started\n"
    assert captured.err == ""


def test_level_and_message_kept_verbatim(capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str]) -> None:
    log_line("WARN", "disk 91% full: /var")
    assert capsys.readouterr().out == "[WARN] disk 91% full: /var\n"


def test_each_call_prints_its_own_line(capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str]) -> None:
    log_line("DEBUG", "a")
    log_line("ERROR", "b")
    assert capsys.readouterr().out == "[DEBUG] a\n[ERROR] b\n"


def test_does_not_touch_file_system(
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch, capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str]
) -> None:
    def _no_open(*args: object, **kwargs: object) -> NoReturn:
        raise AssertionError("log_line must not open files")

    monkeypatch.setattr(builtins, "open", _no_open)
    log_line("INFO", "console only")
    assert capsys.readouterr().out == "[INFO] console only\n"
